groups.title: Commercial & Industrial HVAC
groups.summary: Design, installation and service for commercial, industrial and institutional HVAC, including hazardous locations.
groups.intro: Hudson Mechanical is a premier HVAC company serving Houston and the surrounding areas, with experience across commercial, industrial, and institutional applications. about.title: Houston's trusted partner for industrial and commercial HVAC
text: Hudson Mechanical has served the Houston area with HVAC services that businesses can rely on across chemical, marine, healthcare, and commercial sectors.

We are a full-service HVAC contractor serving industrial and commercial clients throughout the Houston region. We support facilities in demanding environments, from chemical plants and refineries to healthcare campuses and schools. Our installation, maintenance, and emergency repair services prioritize uptime and safety.

Our expertise covers industrial chill water systems, explosion-proof AC and HVAC repair in hazardous locations, NFPA 496 building pressurization, and corrosion-resistant equipment for demanding environments, alongside standard commercial HVAC work. Our in-house sheet metal shop allows us to fabricate custom ductwork without outside vendors, savings we pass on to our customers.
Safety is our top priority. All employees carry TWIC cards, and our team is ISNetworld and PICS certified, credentials that matter for industrial site access across the Houston area.

faqs.q: What services does Hudson Mechanical provide?
faqs.a: We provide commercial and industrial HVAC installation, controls and automation, ductwork fabrication, piping, maintenance agreements, and emergency repair.

faqs.q: Do you work on both new construction and existing buildings?
faqs.a: Yes, we support new construction projects as well as retrofits, replacements, and ongoing maintenance for existing facilities.
Yes, we offer design-build and project management services, taking a project from concept through completion.
Yes, rental water chillers and self-contained package units are available to support projects and planned outages.

faqs.q: Is emergency service available on weekends and holidays?
faqs.a: Yes, emergency HVAC repair is available 24/7, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

faqs.q: How often should commercial HVAC systems be serviced?
faqs.a: Most commercial systems benefit from at least twice-a-year maintenance visits, though high-use industrial equipment may need more frequent service.
Yes, we operate our own custom sheet metal shop with a 20-foot Vicon plasma table, letting us fabricate ductwork to exact specifications.

faqs.q: Do you have experience with hazardous location requirements?
faqs.a: Yes, explosion-proof and NFPA 496 compliant systems are a core part of our work in chemical, refinery, and compressor station environments.

faqs.q: Can you help reduce our building's energy costs?
faqs.a: Our energy audits and efficiency assessments identify opportunities to reduce operating costs while maintaining comfort.

faqs.q: Do you service multiple properties under one agreement?
faqs.a: Yes, our service agreements can be structured to cover multiple properties under a single point of contact.

faqs.q: Can installation work be scheduled around the school year?
faqs.a: Yes, we work with schools and universities to schedule major installation and renovation work during breaks and off-peak periods where possible.

faqs.q: Do you install fume hood exhaust systems?
faqs.a: Yes, we design and install fume hoods, exhaust fans, and supply fans with VFD controls for laboratory and research applications.

faqs.q: Can you support planned refinery turnarounds?
faqs.a: Yes, rental chillers and package units are available to maintain climate control during planned outages and turnarounds.
